title: Simple Home Edit's Beef Burger
steps: Combine beef, breadcrumbs, egg, Worcestershire sauce, half the ketchup, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Divide the mixture into 4 portions and shape them into patties slightly larger than your buns.
Press a thumb into the center of each patty to prevent shrinking while cooking in the pan.
Heat olive oil in a heavy frying pan over medium-high heat and cook patties for 10 to 12 minutes.
Turn the patties halfway through cooking and optionally add water in the final two minutes.
Assemble the toasted brioche buns with cooked patties, cheese, vegetables, and desired condiments.
